x00003: A Date with Diane
x00005: The goal of the game is to get your girlfriend desperate on a date. It is not guaranteed! Along the way you may have other pleasures: see her take a pee, even go into the loo with her, have her tell you about a desperation experience, spot another desperate girl, etc. It’s that simple. Intimacy points indicate how much she’s into you, and she might abandon the date if they sink too low. She will also abandon the date if she wets herself in public, and will probably never see you again, so you mustn’t let that happen.
x00006: A few notes about the game.

x00008: There are five different successful endings, or ‘winning results’, rated in order. See if you can get them all!
x00009: There are also a few consolation endings, and you might even be able to win a date with Amanda.
x00010: The bladder meter shows how much Diane’s holding. What’s in her tummy slowly flows into her bladder as time passes. Also, you get 3 luckshots that you should use wisely when offered, and remember, they can bring bad luck too! Note that you cannot use more than one of these at the end of the evening, once you’ve got the bus or taxi home.
x00011: Don’t expect to sleep with her on this first date, but you might get some fun if you play your cards right. And never forget: women are funny creatures.
x00012: As the evening progresses, your intimacy points should rise, and they naturally affect what you can do. In some scenes, shyness points also come into play, and the number earned or lost by the time you arrive home can influence events. In some scenarios a high figure helps; in others, a low figure helps, so this works rather like a joker card.
x00013: You start with £100. Keep an eye on your money. You might want some for a taxi home at the end of the evening.
x00014: There are lots of variations, so do play the game right through a few times. But on Tuesdays and Thursdays you will also find a shorter version.
